name: PREDNISOLONE / SULFACETAMIDE 10/10 ML SUSPENSION OPHTHALMIC DROPS 10 ML
description: Prednisolone with sulfacetamide eye drop suspension is used to treat eye infections and inflammation. Prednisolone, a corticosteroid, reduces inflammation, and sulfacetamide, an antibiotic, fights bacteria. The most common dosage on the Mexican market contains 5 mg of prednisolone and 100 mg of sulfacetamide per milliliter. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
